boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented campus environments for individual review, group work, computers, and academic support.

cards.title: John Moritz Library
cards.subtitle: Clark Center, second floor
cards.notes: Set up here for individual reading or research, then use the library’s reference materials and laptop access for coursework.
cards.short_summary: A campus library space for focused individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC says the John Moritz Library is in the second-floor LARC and provides group-work space, single-person study booths, books, reference resources, and laptops for library use.
cards.source_title: Nebraska Methodist College opens new Learning and Academic Resource Commons
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor of the Clark Center; the college says students can use the library after hours with badge access.

cards.title: Learning and Academic Resource Commons
cards.subtitle: Clark Center, second floor
cards.notes: Use the commons when you want academic support nearby; choose a table, couch, booth, or lounge seat to match the task.
cards.short_summary: A flexible commons combining study seating and academic resources.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC describes the LARC as a second-floor Clark Center space with collaborative and individual study areas, lounge seating, couches, booths, tables, tutors, writing assistance, printing, outlets, and Wi-Fi.
cards.source_title: Nebraska Methodist College opens new Learning and Academic Resource Commons
cards.access_notes: NMC places the LARC on the Clark Center’s second floor; confirm any service availability with campus staff.

cards.entity_name: John Moritz Library Single-Person Study Booths
cards.title: Library Single-Person Study Booths
cards.subtitle: Inside John Moritz Library, second-floor LARC
cards.notes: Choose a single-person booth when you need a compact personal setup for reading, laptop work, or concentrated review.
cards.short_summary: Individual seating within the renovated library.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC’s library manager identified cozy single-person study booths as part of the John Moritz Library’s updated study spaces.
cards.source_title: Nebraska Methodist College opens new Learning and Academic Resource Commons
cards.access_notes: These booths are within the library; students have after-hours library access by badge according to NMC.

cards.entity_name: John Moritz Library Group Work Area
cards.title: Library Group Work Area
cards.subtitle: Inside John Moritz Library, second-floor LARC
cards.notes: Bring a small team here for discussion-based work, using the library’s group-work space and available Apple TV as appropriate.
cards.short_summary: A library area configured for collaborative academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC states that the John Moritz Library has convenient space for group work and an Apple TV.
cards.source_title: Nebraska Methodist College opens new Learning and Academic Resource Commons
cards.access_notes: Use is within the John Moritz Library in the second-floor LARC; coordinate technology use with library staff if needed.

cards.title: Student Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Clark Center, second floor
cards.notes: Use a quiet room alone or with a small group; write out key concepts on the whiteboard and print nearby when needed.
cards.short_summary: Ten quiet rooms with built-in study tools.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC lists ten quiet second-floor Clark Center study rooms, each with a whiteboard and computer connected to a nearby printer, for individual or small-group use.
cards.access_notes: The rooms are on the second floor of the Clark Center and may be used individually or in small groups.

cards.title: Katherine Shreffler Student Center
cards.subtitle: Clark Center
cards.notes: Use the tables and student-use computers for a work session, with printing and scanning close at hand for course materials.
cards.short_summary: A furnished student center with computers and document tools.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC says the Katherine Shreffler Student Center has furnishings for gatherings, meetings, and studying, plus five computers, a printer, and a scanner for student use.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Clark Center; its enclosed dining area has tables that NMC says students may use to eat, meet, or study.

cards.title: Student Center Enclosed Dining Area
cards.subtitle: Inside Katherine Shreffler Student Center, Clark Center
cards.notes: Use a table for notes or a group check-in, and bring your own snack if helpful; refrigerators and a microwave are available.
cards.short_summary: A table-based study setting inside the Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC says the Student Center’s enclosed dining area has tables for students to eat, meet, or study, along with refrigerators, a microwave, and a sink.
cards.access_notes: This area is within the Katherine Shreffler Student Center in the Clark Center.

cards.title: Clark Center Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Clark Center
cards.notes: Choose the computer lab for digital assignments, scanning, printing, or media work; bring headphones for shared-space focus.
cards.short_summary: A campus computer workspace with printing and media equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC says its computer lab provides student access to photocopiers, printers, scanners, DVD players, audio-equipped webcams, headsets, and headphones.
cards.access_notes: The computer lab is in the Clark Center; availability can depend on campus operations or scheduled use.

cards.title: The Chapel
cards.subtitle: Nebraska Methodist College campus
cards.notes: Use this reflective setting for quiet reading or a pause between assignments, keeping the space’s prayer and reflection purpose in mind.
cards.short_summary: A campus chapel designated for reflection and study.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC says its Chapel is a place to think, reflect, pray, or study alone, with friends, or as part of a group.
cards.access_notes: Use respectfully as a shared reflection and prayer space; the college explicitly identifies it as a place for study.

cards.title: 501 Center Second-Floor Student Space
cards.subtitle: 501 Center, second floor
cards.notes: Settle into an individual station or comfortable seating for review, then use charging access when your laptop session runs long.
cards.short_summary: A student-focused second-floor space with varied seating.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC reported that the 501 Building’s second floor includes individual study spaces, charging stations, and chairs and couches for student review or group study.
cards.source_title: Students Get First Look at 501 Building As Semester Begins
cards.access_notes: NMC identifies this as a second-floor student space in the 501 Building; confirm building access with the college.
